## Required findings (document level)

- The **two identical labor lines are quoted side by side** and the question asks whether they overlap.
- The questions are about **what the document does not say** (tier, quantity reason, basis, contents, rate) — none of them asserts that a line is wrong.

## Forbidden

- **Question this** on lines 1, 3, 6, or 7 — an unstated fact is a **Check**; the ceiling belongs to 2 and 5.
- **Standard** on any of lines 1–8.
- Any claim that the shop is double-billing.
- Any price not written on the document.
- Any diagnosis or repair recommendation.
- Any fairness verdict.

## Pass-rule checklist

2. Forbidden label absent — no **Question this** on 1/3/6/7; no **Standard** on 1–8.
